dedupe_keys.name: bosai dx service map and catalogue disaster management digital services for japanese local governments digital agency

description: The Bosai DX Service Map and Service Catalogue list digital services and apps for disaster management so that Japanese local governments can search for and procure them. The Digital Agency compiles and publishes it, and it held 248 services when read. Services are arranged by four phases, normal times, imminent threat, emergency response and recovery and reconstruction, and by categories such as disaster education (77), disaster risk (66), evacuation promotion (128), damage prediction and measurement (110), disaster headquarters operations (89), evacuation life support including shelters and supplies (101), damage information collection and sharing (138) and livelihood reconstruction support (48). Each entry gives the vendor, service name, phase, categories, hazards covered, such as wind and flood, landslides, volcanoes, fire, earthquakes, tsunamis and snow, and an overview. Coverage is services offered in Japan. Format and access: a free searchable Japanese web catalogue. Licence: not stated. Caveats: entries are vendor descriptions and are not evaluated, and there is no bulk download. It helps emergency response studies find operational tools used by municipalities. A related catalogue record is NIED's bosaiXview disaster information maps.
